run_grid_search: run a hyperparameter grid search for QA training jobs using submitit on a SLURM cluster
run_grid_parameters: run the grid_parameters function to yield all combinations of parameters in a given grid dict
run_get_init_file: run get_init_file to create a unique UUID-named init file in the shared folder for distributed training
run_get_shared_folder: run get_shared_folder to return the shared checkpoint path for multi-hop QA experiments
run_main: run the main entry point to parse training args and launch a grid search sweep
